title: Sum a comma list
prompt: Implement `static int SumList(string csv)` — input like `"3,4,10"`; split on commas, parse each piece, return the sum. Any unparseable piece makes the whole input invalid: return `-1`.

tests.name: all-valid
tests.hint: Every piece must parse; negatives are legal values.

tests.name: one-bad-piece
tests.hint: One bad piece poisons the whole list — fail closed.
